Apple is preparing to launch its latest flagship phones, the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, continuing the company's long-standing pattern of new releases. Below are our expectations for the iPhone 18 Pro announcement and release dates, along with relevant details about this product line.

The iPhone 18 Pro announcement will take place in September, but there is one detail worth paying attention to.

The iPhone is Apple's most important product, accounting for the largest share of the company's revenue. One way Apple keeps the iPhone business thriving is by releasing a new flagship model every year.

For many years, these new iPhone models have been announced in September, and all signs point to the same timeline being followed this year.

Here are the dates of the most recent three iPhone announcements:

  • 2025: September 9 (Tuesday)
  • 2024: September 9 (Monday)
  • 2023: September 12 (Tuesday)

As you can see, Apple's iPhone announcement schedule is extremely consistent, with the main flagship models typically debuting around the second week of September.

The variable this year is that Labor Day falls unusually late, on September 7. Apple is unlikely to ask the media to attend an event on a U.S. federal holiday, so September 8 is essentially ruled out.

That means the earliest possible date for the announcement would be September 9 (Wednesday).

September 9 lines up with the dates of the past two years and is also consistent with what Apple did in 2022, when the new iPhone was unveiled two days after Labor Day.

If September 9 ultimately does not work out, the latest expected announcement date would shift to the beginning of the following week.

Regardless, the iPhone 18 Pro will officially debut sometime in early to mid September.

However, one major change is expected this year: the standard iPhone 18 will not go on sale until early 2027. According to reports, Apple's flagship lineup this fall will only include three models:

iPhone 18 Pro expected release date

Although the exact date of the Apple iPhone announcement may shift slightly due to Labor Day, the post-announcement rollout schedule is fairly consistent: new phones typically go on sale the Friday after the announcement.

Therefore, if the iPhone 18 Pro is unveiled on September 9 (Wednesday), pre-orders will open on September 11 (or be pushed to Saturday, September 12, to avoid the September 11 memorial), and the new devices will officially reach users on Friday, September 18.

A look back at Apple's recent iPhone announcement history confirms this pattern.

2025: iPhone 17

  • Announcement date: September 9 (Tuesday)
  • Pre-order date: September 12 (Friday)
  • Release date: September 19 (Friday)

2024: iPhone 16

  • Announcement date: September 9 (Monday)
  • Pre-order date: September 13 (Friday)
  • Release date: September 20 (Friday)

2023: iPhone 15

  • Announcement date: September 12 (Tuesday)
  • Pre-order date: September 15 (Friday)
  • Release date: September 22 (Friday)

Unless Apple breaks with its usual practice this year, September 18 will be the day users can get their hands on the iPhone 18 Pro.

iPhone 18 Pro release date: summary

In summary, based on Apple's past patterns, here are our predictions for the iPhone 18 lineup's announcement and release dates.

2026: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, iPhone Ultra

  • Announcement date: September 9 (Wednesday)
  • Pre-order date: September 11 (Friday) or September 12 (Saturday)
  • Release date: September 18 (Friday)

The iPhone Ultra may launch slightly later than the iPhone 18 Pro, but there is no confirmed information at this point.

Which new iPhone 18 model are you planning to buy? Let us know in the comments.
